questions.question: The settlers in Samaria worshiped the LORD but also served their own gods. What did they follow from their homelands?
When lions began killing the settlers the king of Assyria had sent, what reason did they give him?

answers.text: They did not know what the God of the land required
Their towns had no walls to keep the lions out
The land had sat empty and wild for too long

questions.question: To teach the settlers how to worship the God of the land, who did the king of Assyria command to be sent?

answers.text: One of the priests carried off from Samaria
One of the prophets living in Judah
One of his own officials from Assyria

questions.question: The LORD told the Israelites to worship Him alone. What did He promise if they did?

answers.text: He would deliver them from all their enemies
He would give them a king who rules forever
He would send them rain in every season
